values.value: Restore price on required bundle option (Quote Line {primaryRecordId})

1. Open Quote Line {primaryRecordId}. The required option is priced at $0 but the product carries a non-zero list price. 2. Confirm whether the option is intentionally free (verify with the deal owner). 3. If not intentional: restore SBQQ__NetPrice from the PricebookEntry list, or re-trigger the Price Rule path. 4. If intentional: add a finding suppression with note "option intentionally bundled at $0 for this segment." 5. Verify the PricebookEntry actually exists for this product+pricebook — missing PBE is a common root cause.
Confirmed intentional bundling at $0 for this segment.
Price restored from PricebookEntry list; line repriced.
Missing Pricebook Entry created and quote recalculated.
